subject: general
question: Choose the antonym of 'Wan'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Healthy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Wan"** means pale and giving the impression of illness or exhaustion. It is often used to describe someone's appearance when they look sickly or lacking energy. (फीका / म्लान)

 
 
• **Example:** She looked wan after working long hours without any rest.
 
 
 
• **"Healthy"** refers to being in good physical or mental condition, not showing signs of illness or weakness. (स्वस्थ)
 
 
• **Example:** Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for staying healthy.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Wan'** is **'Healthy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Healthy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tiring** (थकाने वाला): Causing one to feel exhausted or fatigued.

 
 
• **Example:** The long hike up the mountain was tiring but rewarding.
 
 
 
• **Long** (लंबा): Measuring a great distance from end to end or taking a lot of time.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a long journey to reach the remote village.
 
 
 
• **Wearisome** (थकाऊ): Causing fatigue or boredom; monotonous or tedious.
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture became wearisome after two hours of non-stop talking.
